details: Bitcoin dropped to around $74,654 on Saturday, extending weekly losses as investors remain cautious. Ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz affecting oil prices, and uncertainty over U.S. crypto regulation are weighing on sentiment. The Federal Reserve's latest meeting minutes also indicate policymakers are open to further interest rate hikes if inflation persists, dampening overall risk appetite across crypto markets.
title: Bitcoin Dips Amid Mideast Tensions and Fed Rate Hike Concerns

details: Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT) is reportedly preparing to sell a substantial amount of its Bitcoin holdings, approximately 2,650 BTC valued at $205 million, after transferring the digital assets to the Crypto.com exchange. This move follows the company's significant first-quarter net loss and substantial unrealized losses on its cryptocurrency portfolio, indicating a potential liquidation effort to address financial challenges.
title: Trump Media to Liquidate Major Bitcoin Holdings Amid Losses

details: The Layer-1 blockchain Near Protocol's native token ($NEAR) experienced a significant price surge of over 25% in the last 24 hours. This rally follows the announcement of a major network upgrade focused on automated scaling and enhanced quantum resilience. The positive technological development has sparked investor interest and driven notable price action for the altcoin.
title: NEAR Protocol Token Surges 25% on Major Scaling Upgrade
